text:
Alex: Who's up for a 'Pocket Gauntlet' handheld LAN tonight? Bring Switch/Steam Deck/phones — low-key speedrun/party mix. Thinking game room, pizza, power strips. 7pm? RSVP with what you can bring (controller / cables / switch).
Priya: I'm in! Bringing my Steam Deck + dock and can bring a 5-port ethernet switch. :metal:
jamie: Maybe! 7 is a bit early for me, 8pm would be much better. Also need a spare USB-C cable if anyone has one.
Sam: @Alex 8pm works for me too. I can bring Smash + extra joy-cons. I also have an HDMI capture if someone wants to clip bad plays.
Alex: Sounds like 8pm gets more people — moving to 20:00 in the game room unless someone absolutely can't. Pizza poll: react with :pizza: for pizza, :hamburger: for burgers, :taco: for tacos.
Chris: :pizza: (thin crust please). Also @Marta you in? You still owe me a rematch from last time :smile:
Marta: In! I'll bring a wired controller and a power bank. I can also bring a small surge protector.
oncall-bot: Reminder: Game room reserved 20:00-23:30. Please return chairs to storage after event.
Sam: Pro tip — office Wi‑Fi is flaky for local hosting. Plan for switch + direct connections. If anyone wants to remote in, we can run Parsec: host IP 10.0.1.12, command: `parsec-host --password gauntlet`
Priya: Can someone pick up extra ethernet cables? I only have one spare CAT6.
Alex: I can bring 4x 1m cables and two power strips. Who wants pizza? Current tally: :pizza: 3, :taco: 1, :hamburger: 0
jamie: I'll swing by with a USB-C cable and maybe a charging dock. Also prefer 8pm — saves me from racing over after dinner.
Chris: :thumbsup: If we hit 6+ players I can run a quick double-elim bracket. Otherwise we'll do casual rotation. See you all at 20:00 — bringing snacks too.
Marta: Quick logistics note: there's only one wall outlet by the couch, so let's cluster power strips and keep surge protectors between big batteries.
Alex: Noted. I'll pin this thread and add a short checklist in #lunch-plans for pizza order. If anyone's streaming, DM me so we can set up capture schedule.
Sam: Streaming maybe — will ask first. If streaming, grab my capture and I can handle OBS scenes.
Priya: Awesome. Count me in for thin crust + extra napkins.
Alex: Final check — bringing: 5-port switch (Priya), HDMI capture (Sam), extra joy-cons (Sam), USB-C cable (jamie), power strips & cables (Alex), wired controller & surge protector (Marta). Party at 20:00.
Chris: Let's try to keep the trash swept too, lol.
Alex: Agreed. See ya!
